Progress: Fault localization complete. No project source or tests changed.
- CurrentDeviceSection.tsx renders a string-only SettingsSubsection heading. The only current-device sign-out control is in DeviceDetails, visible after expansion. Add a heading node using SettingsSubsectionHeading and a persistent kebab trigger; disable it for loading, absent device, or sign-out progress, and pass reusable localized action nodes.
- SessionManagerTab.tsx already has onSignOutCurrentDevice (LogoutDialog) and onSignOutOtherDevices (deleteDevicesWithInteractiveAuth). It computes otherDevices; the new bulk menu action should pass Object.keys(otherDevices), only when nonempty.
- ContextMenu.tsx currently stops menu clicks at onClick without closing; background click and Escape/Tab do close. Closing unmounts and restores initial focus. A close-on-interaction path must call onFinished for item activation, including keyboard activation, without blocking item action.
- IconizedContextMenuOption delegates label to MenuItem; MenuItem derives aria-label from label. Existing red option-list styles use $alert but lack explicit focus treatment.
- No KebabContextMenu.tsx exists. Existing ContextMenuButton/useContextMenu handle aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, keyboard activation, and state. aboveLeftOf can place above when near bottom, so below-only positioning needs explicit coordinates.
- Existing tests cover detail-level sign-out and bulk deletion but no header menu behavior. Suggested cases: disabled trigger states; menu visibility/keyboard/focus; conditional bulk item; exact noncurrent IDs; click and keyboard close; destructive styling.
